title: Characterization of selected memory instructions
statement: Let $A$ be a program with memory instructions, and let $q$ be a compiled-machine state. If the memory-operation selector returns instruction $i$ at $q$, then there is a program state $l$ such that $q$ is the program-running state at $l$ with its phase at the start, $A$ assigns instruction $i$ to $l$, and $i$ is a memory instruction.
